title: Add pointer-based memory index for conversation logs
body:
## Summary

- New `VCC_memory.py` module: pointer-based memory index that stores only metadata and file/line pointers, no content summaries — consistent with VCC's projection philosophy
- Supports `index`, `search`, `search --fuzzy`, `timeline`, `mark/unmark`, `gc`, `stats` commands
- Auto-indexes during VCC compilation via a lightweight hook in `VCC.py` (best-effort, never blocks compilation)
- New `/remember` skill, updated `/recall` and `/searchchat` with memory fallback

## Test plan

- [ ] Compile a test JSONL, verify `~/.claude/vcc_memory/index.json` is created automatically
- [ ] Run `VCC_memory.py search "keyword"` and `search --fuzzy` against indexed conversations
- [ ] Test `mark`, `unmark`, `timeline`, `gc`, `stats` commands
- [ ] Verify existing VCC compilation is unaffected when memory module is absent
